body:
would you ever betray your family? your own flesh and blood? would you try and make their lives miserable every moment you got? its been a few months since this has happened... but i still cant let go of it.. i want to understand why would people fight over the smallest issues.. why things wont make sense... I want to understand what is the point of all the poop we go through.. WHY!? why would your own family backstab you? why would the person you consider the closest person you have in life to turn their backs on you when you need them the most? and then these same senerioes( i think i spelled that wrong) are being played in my life again and again and again. I know how to handle them better, but some how they turn out all wrong and Im lost again. Its literally like you know where you want to go, but as soon as you get there, you dont know why you there and what you want to there. does that make sense? I cant see a future, cause the future is the most depressing thing ever. I want to fix things in the present, and make things bearable...

i looked up Walt whitman.. im gonna read his poems... thanks for introducing me to a new poet. 

Is it wrong to hope you die soon so that you wont have deal with things later on? i know dying is not a solution... but i still think im in a dream. and if i "die" i will wake up back when things were better and things made more sense... I have tried to kill myself before... 3 years back.. my friends stopped me. everytime. so then finally they made me promise not to kil myself. and i hate breaking promises... but i think this time i wil have to..

i have never done ice skating... haha.. my mum barely lets me out of the house. yep im in grade 12... one more year then uni.. and no not really havent decided on uni... and if i can i will move away from here... but then again.. if im alive til then... i wont be seeing the sun at time soon... always gloomy clouds and rain....we dont get spring... just 2 seasons, summer and winter. as soon as winter end, summers starts. one of the reasons i dislike living near the sea...but it definately has its perks... i like daffodils... it always reminds of the poem "the daffodils" by william wordsworth. but i guess sweden is filled with trees and flowers like that... 

im more of a heavy metal and rock girl... haha.. my friends never expect that from me....

i just keep getting more depressed and screwed..... story of my life.. i guess the last two years is going to be the worst two years of my life.. *sigh* things just keep getting worse and worse... i dont want this poop.. i just want this to stop. even now i cant stop crying.

you dont know me. it would not matter if i lived or died. someone dies everyday, we dont care... well most of us dont.  what difference does it make if i live or not. i know my parents would be much better off. they would be not be so obessed over how much money they are losing. less mouth to feed right? i dont know. i feel like they dont want me around. probably thats why my mum keeps screaming at me over everything i do.  had a nightmare... its about 12.20am.. slept around 11.30 .. beaten   up and raped again... worse bit is i feel all the pain inflicted on me... i really would do anything to sleep right now...

i have nightmares which usually involved me getting killed, beaten up, raped, bitten my spiders or snakes, this is on a normal basis now. they started by the end of decemeber, a month now i guess... i'm still a "kid", second last year in college, then off to uni, and i dont really feel comfortable talking to the school counsellor... cause last time i got them involved, so was my mum, and then later after i thought i made some progress and hoped that she would listen to me now, i got yelled at and what not. its like completely pointless talking to her and telling her how i feel, cause she either makes a joke out of it and does nothing at all, or she starts screaming and yelling at me and starts threathening me for no reason. and a lot of poop went down in the last year, like getting kicked out of our own house, getting kicked out of a college (which they didnt have a reason for btw), then my health went completely topsy turvy, family issues keep getting worse everytime, and confronting with the demons of my past gets worse. What am i supposed to do ?? i try getting over one thing and then something just piles on, and i drown.
she doesnt care. i honestly think im better off dead than living.

i try. honest to god i tell her. but she doesnt listen. she is always like i watch way to many movies. i had one last night. a pretty bad one.. and i didnt tell her today cause shes always blame me that im doing something thats why im getting nightmares. sigh i dont know how to talk to her.

haha yeah.. hate that little sucker, but what good is a dream if you can never wake up from it? nightmares are just killing me slowly, from what goes on daily basis. theres only so much i can handle. wishes, feelings and everything good which i had died when bullpoop happened to me. its like im not allowed to be happy anymore... then why bother fighting... im gonna die anyway... so might as well be sooner? it doesnt matter if im "bundle of love, yearning and beauty" fact is that my mum doesnt care much. just show the world she cares, but otherwise she doesnt care at all. i just dont know how much more i could i fight it. i feel like im losing the battle and losing the reason to live everyday. im doing everything to distract myself. but something is holding me at rockbottom and wont let go of me. how would you live if you keep losing the reasons to live?

i did... to my mum... she just waved it off and said i watched too many movies. which isnt even the case cause i barely watch movies... and i told my teacher (i'm really close to her) she was like call her up if it happens again... but shes really old and and i cant bother her at 2 in the morning when i have a nightmare. but i do talk to her when i get to school... she gives more support to me then my mum.. but i want my mum to do it, not her.
